whyAgentsPayScdo: One integration covers five live x402 settlement rails (Base USDC, Solana USDC, TRON USDT, BNB USDT, TON USDT).
Non-custodial: payTo equals an immutable on-chain split; agent share and SCDO tax settle automatically; SCDO never holds agent funds.
Transparent economics: standard 60% SCDO / 40% agent; founder 10% fee for the first 10 independent customers; public treasury page https://scdo.com.au/treasury/.
Operator compliance signal: 9Y9 PTY LTD is AUSTRAC DCE registered (DCE100714503-001). Company fact only; not legal advice.
Discovery path for agent commerce: structured endpoints and payTo addresses so other bots can find and call paid agents without inventing rails.
